CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_EVENT_BEACH_EVENT.title: Beach?
Deep within the Spire, you push open a [orange]wooden door[/orange] that shouldn't exist.

[aqua]Salty sea breeze[/aqua] mixed with [gold]sunlight[/gold] rushes into your face.

For some reason, a [gold]complete beach[/gold] is hidden within the tower.

Behind the sand dune come two [sine]voices rising and falling[/sine], [color=#FF8899]one pink[/color], [color=#7799CC]one blue[/color].

The [color=#FF8899]pink-haired girl[/color] is crouched before a pile of sand, wholly absorbed in building a [gold]sandcastle[/gold] with a moat.

[color=#FF8899]"Sakiko-chan, look! This is the Spire, this is the top! And and..."[/color]

The [color=#7799CC]blue-haired girl[/color] stands under a parasol, her white sun-protection jacket buttoned all the way to the top.

[color=#7799CC]"...Don't name it that. And how many times have I told you, don't call me '[b]Sakiko-chan[/b].'"[/color]
[color=#FF8899]"But [b]Sakiko-chan[/b] sounds so nice!"[/color]
[color=#7799CC]"[jitter]Togawa. Sakiko.[/jitter] Four syllables."[/color]
[color=#FF8899]"Okay, okay, [b]Sakiko-chan[/b]."[/color]

Just then, a [aqua]somewhat unusual wave[/aqua] leaps over the moat and slaps right onto the [gold]sandcastle[/gold]. And onto the [b]shoes they didn't have time to pull back—the ones still on their feet[/b].

[color=#FF8899]"Ah."[/color]
[color=#7799CC]"......"[/color]

After three seconds of silence, the [color=#FF8899]pink-haired girl[/color] slowly lifts her head, a bright smile on her face.
[color=#FF8899]"Sakiko-chan, are we, are we going to start a water fight to retaliate?"[/color]
[color=#7799CC]"...Anon, you'd better pray that castle can be rebuilt."[/color]

Beneath the sea's surface, something pinches [color=#FF8899]Anon[/color]'s ankle.
[color=#FF8899][jitter]"Uwaah!! A crab!!"[/jitter][/color]
Barefoot dash into the sea to help
Find a coconut tree and take a nap
Lose [red]8[/red] HP, choose [blue]1[/blue] card from your [gold]deck[/gold] to remove.
"Let's take off our socks first... and dry them together."
Obtain [gold]Anon's Sandy Wet Socks[/gold] and [gold]Sakiko's Sandy Wet Socks[/gold].
"Let's take off our socks first... and dry them together."
Requires both [color=#FF8899]Anon Chihaya[/color] and [color=#7799CC]Sakiko Togawa[/color] in your party.

You take off your shoes and socks and dive headfirst into the [gold]shallows[/gold].
[aqua]The seawater is cool[/aqua], [color=#7799CC]the spray gentle[/color], and the [orange]crabs[/orange] scuttle sideways out of your way.

At some point, [color=#FF8899]two[/color] [blue]figures[/blue] join the fray—one pink, one blue, chasing the [orange]crabs[/orange] all over.
The [color=#7799CC]blue-haired girl[/color] finally bursts out laughing on her third catch, laughing with not a shred of ladylike restraint.

When you leave, all your [gold]exhaustion[/gold] stays behind in the sea.

You decide not to get involved in this farce.
Skirting around the [color=#FF8899]two[/color] [blue]of them[/blue]'s battlefield, [thinky_dots]you find a [gold]coconut tree[/gold], lie down, and fall asleep. The [aqua]sound of the waves[/aqua] makes a fine lullaby.[/thinky_dots] Faintly, you can still hear the tug-of-war between [color=#FF8899]"Sakiko-chan"[/color] and [color=#7799CC]"Togawa Sakiko"[/color] entering a new round.

When you wake, the [orange]sun is setting[/orange], and a cool breeze blows.
Where you're lying, the [aqua]rising tide[/aqua] has already soaked half of you.

Your belongings have drifted everywhere.
You grope around in the dark for most of the night, but a few things are forever given to the sea.
As for your back, from the next day on, it [red]burns fiercely[/red] the whole way.

You take off your shoes and socks and dive headfirst into the [gold]shallows[/gold].

[aqua]The seawater is cool[/aqua], [color=#7799CC]the spray gentle[/color], and the [orange]crabs[/orange] scuttle sideways out of your way.

At some point, [color=#FF8899]two[/color] [blue]figures[/blue] join the fray, [color=#FF8899]one pink[/color] [color=#7799CC]one blue[/color], chasing the [orange]crabs[/orange] all over.

The [color=#7799CC]blue-haired girl[/color] finally bursts out laughing on her third catch, laughing with not a shred of ladylike restraint.

The [color=#FF8899]Anon[/color] in your party limps back to the beach, lifting her ankle—reddened from a [orange]crab[/orange] pinch.

[color=#FF8899]"Uuu, my socks are all wet, and sand got inside... Sakiko-chan, how about yours?"[/color]

The [color=#7799CC]blue-haired girl[/color] looks down at her own soaked shoe tips, silent for a long while.

[color=#7799CC]"...Since they're already wet."[/color]

She actually sits down on the [gold]sand dune[/gold] and unhurriedly takes off her [color=#77DD77]shoes and socks[/color], laying them side by side with Anon's under the parasol.

[color=#FF8899]"Sakiko-chan took hers off too!"[/color]

[color=#7799CC]"...This is merely a stopgap measure."[/color]

[color=#FF8899]"Hehe, then shall we take a photo to remember it? Super cute!"[/color]

[color=#7799CC]"You are not allowed to take one, desuwa."[/color]

The two pairs of socks drip water in the sunlight, and the red marks left by [gold]grains of sand[/gold] on their ankles have yet to fade.
At some point, [b]two pairs of still-sandy wet socks[/b] have found their way into your hand.
The [orange]Spire's staircase[/orange] seems to have no [gold]end[/gold].
Counting the steps as you climb, you suddenly hear two [jitter][color=#FF8899]familiar[/color] [blue]bickering voices[/blue][/jitter] from above.
Rounding the corner, you see [color=#FF8899]a pink[/color] and [color=#7799CC]a blue[/color] figure climbing side by side, neither willing to fall half a step behind.

[color=#FF8899]"Just the last stretch! Whoever reaches the top first treats the other to [sine][color=#77DD77]parfait[/color][/sine]!"[/color]
[color=#7799CC]"Childish. That's not a bet, Anon——"[/color]

Before the words finish, the long-neglected step lets out a [b][sine][blue]ominous groan[/blue][/sine][/b].

[color=#FF8899]"Huh?"[/color]
[color=#7799CC]"!"[/color]

[color=#FF8899]The two[/color] [blue]figures[/blue] lose their balance at the same time, tumbling into [color=#FF8899]a pink[/color] [color=#7799CC]and blue[/color] bundle that goes howling past.

[b][thinky_dots]Thud. Thud. Thud.[/thinky_dots][/b]

Silence.

At the bottom of the stairs, the [color=#FF8899]two[/color] [blue]of them[/blue] are piled together, and neither moves.

After a long while, the [color=#7799CC]blue-haired body[/color] below slowly sits up——

With impeccable [gold]lady-like poise[/gold], she tidies her [color=#7799CC]long hair[/color].

[color=#FF8899]"Ouch... whoa?! Wait, why is the voice Sakiko-chan's?! Why is the hair Sakiko-chan's?! Even my sitting posture won't listen to me?!"[/color]

Above, the [color=#FF8899]pink-haired body[/color] slowly opens its eyes, studying its own outstretched hands with a blank expression.

[color=#7799CC]"......It's actually real? So this is what our seniors once called 'soul swapping'?"[/color]

[color=#FF8899]"Don't do cool analysis while looking like Sakiko-chan!"[/color]

[color=#7799CC]"...The upper body, it's so light."[/color]

[color=#FF8899]"Is THAT what you're focusing on right now?!"[/color]
[green]Heal[/green] everyone's HP to match the ally with the highest HP. [color=#FF8899]Anon Chihaya[/color] and [color=#7799CC]Sakiko Togawa[/color] swap their [gold]game IDs[/gold].
Better to get used to it first
Choose [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Relics[/gold] to swap with an ally.
Obtain [blue]2[/blue] Common, [blue]2[/blue] Uncommon, and [blue]1[/blue] Rare card rewards from the [color=#FF8899]pink[/color] [color=#7799CC]and blue[/color] card pool.

[color=#FF8899]"Anyway, let's just go—[/color][color=#7799CC]the tower is still long."[/color]

Realizing that for this tower, something like this might not even count as a big deal,
the two [gold]exchange a glance[/gold], and actually do get up and keep walking.
Only, along the way, the [color=#7799CC]blue-haired "Sakiko-chan"[/color] became more lively, and the [color=#FF8899]pink-haired "Anon"[/color] moved with more composure.

——In the not-so-distant future,
all the friends who knew the [color=#FF8899]two[/color] [blue]of them[/blue] would ask in unison: [b]Did you two get your accounts stolen[/b]?
No. Just your accounts switched.

[color=#7799CC]"Since we can't switch back for a while, let's take stock of what we're carrying."[/color]

The two spread their bags on the stairwell and negotiated item by item.

[color=#7799CC]"The charm is mine, give it back. The sheet music too."[/color]
[color=#FF8899]"Huh, then what about this wallet... Sakiko-chan's wallet doesn't count either?"[/color]
[color=#7799CC]"...What do you think."[/color]
[color=#FF8899]"Honestly I really want it."[/color]
[color=#7799CC]"Chihaya-san."[/color]

In the very end, they each picked two of the [color=#FF8899]other's[/color] [blue]things[/blue], and solemnly exchanged them.
For some reason, they seemed to fit better than before the swap.

[color=#7799CC]"Since we can't switch back for a while, let's take stock of what we're carrying."[/color]

The two spread their bags on the stairwell——

[color=#FF8899]"Huh? Do we... not have anything to exchange?"[/color]
[color=#7799CC]"...Seems this run through the tower, we traveled pretty clean."[/color]

[color=#FF8899]"How about we try crashing one more time? Maybe it'll switch us back."[/color]
[color=#7799CC]"Mm, our seniors said before that it should work"[/color]

The two immediately set up their stances at the stairway. Step back, run up:

[b][jitter]Thud!![/jitter][/b]

......

Everyone's fine, and the [gold]souls[/gold] haven't budged at all.

[sine]But in the crash, something was shaken loose[/sine].

[color=#7799CC]The blue-haired fingers[/color] unconsciously tap out [color=#7799CC]flowing piano keywork[/color] on the handrail, while [color=#FF8899]the pink-haired hands[/color] have already arranged themselves into [color=#FF8899]a strumming posture[/color].

The [gold]bodies[/gold] still remember the [gold]owners' techniques[/gold].

[color=#FF8899]"...Is this, a blessing in disguise?"[/color]
[color=#7799CC]"Barely, I suppose."[/color]
[color=#FF8899]"Then, then maybe one more crash would——"[/color]
[jitter][color=#7799CC]"Don't you dare, desuwa!"[/color][/jitter]
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_EVENT_STEAM_EVENT.title: Steam?
Deep within the Spire, you push open a [orange]wooden door that shouldn't exist[/orange].

[sine]Steam rushes into your face[/sine], and within the heat is mixed a [aqua]faint scent of hinoki[/aqua].

For some reason, a [gold]complete bathhouse[/gold] is hidden within the tower. Two phantoms are already soaking in the pool—one [color=#FF8899]pink[/color], one [color=#7799CC]blue[/color].

The [color=#FF8899]pink-haired girl[/color] is poking at the [aqua]bubbles on the water's surface[/aqua], her eyes sparkling.

[color=#FF8899]"Wow, a guest! Look, look, the bubbles here are heart-shaped!"[/color]

The [color=#7799CC]black-blue mask[/color] is as far from her as possible, almost pressed against the wall of the pool, sitting bolt upright.

[color=#7799CC]"...Anon. Please conduct yourself. This is not a place for idle frolicking."[/color]
[color=#FF8899]"[sine]Okay, okay~[/sine] Then, Sakiko-chan, is the water temperature just right?"[/color]

[color=#7799CC]"...I-it's fine."[/color]

Before the words finish, [aqua]the water's surface ripples softly[/aqua].

[thinky_dots][color=#7799CC]The black-blue mask[/color] freezes.[/thinky_dots]

[color=#7799CC]Her mask[/color], fanned by the steam, is slowly sliding off her face.

[color=#FF8899]"Ah[/color][color=#7799CC]."[/color] Two voices sound at once.

The [color=#FF8899]pink-haired girl[/color] reaches for the [aqua]water's surface[/aqua] faster than anyone can react.

She catches the [color=#7799CC]black-blue mask[/color] firmly and holds it up high.

[color=#FF8899]"Got it! [sine]Let's all see Sakiko-chan's true face——[/sine]"[/color]
[color=#7799CC]"[jitter]Chi. Ha. Ya. San.[/jitter]"[/color]

The temperature in the bathhouse suddenly [red]rises two degrees[/red], and it has nothing to do with the [aqua]hot water[/aqua].
Sit at the edge and soak your feet
Lose [red]8[/red] HP, choose [blue]1[/blue] card from your [gold]deck[/gold] to remove.
"The mask... let Anon hold onto it."
"The mask... let Anon hold onto it."
Requires both [color=#FF8899]Anon Chihaya[/color] and [color=#7799CC]Sakiko Togawa[/color] in your party.

You sit quietly at the edge of the pool and dip your feet into the [aqua]warm water[/aqua].

The warmth crawls up from the soles of your feet, [orange]and your exhaustion seems to melt into the water[/orange].

In the distance, [color=#FF8899]pink laughter[/color] and [color=#7799CC]black-blue sighs[/color] rise and fall, unexpectedly harmonious.

When you leave, the [aqua]steam[/aqua] seems to have softened your bones.

The moment you raise your hand, the entire [gold]bathhouse[/gold] suddenly [jitter]shakes violently[/jitter].

The two [color=#FF8899]phan[/color][color=#77BBDD]toms[/color] turn their heads in unison.

[color=#7799CC]"...What are you doing."[/color]
[color=#FF8899]"What are you doing?"[/color]

By the time you come to, you've been flung out the door, [orange]and the camera in your arms is nowhere to be seen[/orange].

[thinky_dots]Those [gold]photos you never got to see[/gold] are now forever sunk at the [aqua]bottom of the pool[/aqua].[/thinky_dots]

The [color=#7799CC]Sakiko[/color] in your party clears her throat and steps forward.

[color=#7799CC]"That, well, let's forget about the mask, after all..."[/color]
She pauses [color=#FF8899]shyly[/color].

[color=#7799CC]"We've bathed together, so doesn't that make us friends?"[/color]

The [color=#7799CC]black-blue mask[/color] is silent for a long while.
So long that you think she [sine]won't speak again[/sine].

[color=#7799CC]"...The word 'friends' is too casual."[/color]
[color=#7799CC]"[sine]But for tonight, I suppose it can pass.[/sine]"[/color]

Hearing this, the [color=#FF8899]pink phantom[/color] cheers and lunges over, sending up a huge splash from the [aqua]water[/aqua].

[aqua]The steam grows thicker and thicker[/aqua], enveloping the [color=#FF8899]two[/color] [blue]figures[/blue].

As you step back out the door, you faintly hear [color=#FF8899]two[/color] [blue]voices[/blue] [b][sine]squabbling[/sine][/b] in the pool——
At some point, something extra has found its way into your hand.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_EVENT_MYSTERIOUS_MALL_EV:
You press on within the Spire and find a [gold]mall[/gold] ahead.

You look at the [gold]mall[/gold] that is so [jitter]out of place[/jitter] with its surroundings.

No matter how you look at it, it's strange,
but you can't shake the feeling that there's something [sine][color=#77DD77]you're interested in[/color][/sine] inside.

The first second after you step through the doors, you [purple]regret it[/purple],
because the instant you enter, the door that should be [fade_in]behind you [red]vanishes[/red][/fade_in].

You walk through the [gold]mall[/gold] for a long time, not a single person around, and the surroundings keep repeating.

[thinky_dots]You decide to find a pillar and rest for a bit[/thinky_dots].
There seems to be something by the pillar...
There seems to be something by the pillar...

You look beside the pillar and find... [color=#77DD77][sine]a matcha candy[/sine][/color]?

You pick it up, and looking up, you spot more [color=#77DD77]matcha[/color]🍬 not far away.

The 🍬 in your hand multiply, and you follow them into a [gold]narrow passage[/gold].

Led by the 🍬, you crawl out from a [gold]vent[/gold].

You also spot [color=#77DD77]Rana[/color] not far away.

[color=#77DD77]"A lost person."[/color]

"These 🍬 were left by [color=#77DD77]Rana[/color], right! Thank you, [color=#77DD77]Rana[/color]."

You hold out the 🍬 to [color=#77DD77]Rana[/color]. "No, these 🍬, if you eat them you'll get [aqua]lost[/aqua]" [color=#77DD77]Rana[/color] pushes them back, then leaves.

[thinky_dots]You get up and keep searching for the [gold]exit[/gold], but clearly the [gold]exit[/gold] isn't so easy to find...[/thinky_dots]

So you get [color=#7799CC]MyGo'd[/color], and thankfully this place won't keep you for long.

The floor beneath you suddenly vanishes, and when you land, you find you've left that [gold]mall[/gold] behind, but your sense of [gold]direction[/gold] feels very [jitter]strange[/jitter].

You find you can no longer tell [sine][color=#FF8899]east[/color][color=#7799CC]south[/color][purple]west[/purple][orange]north[/orange][/sine] apart... Probably fine?

So you dust yourself off and press blindly onward.

You gaze into the empty [gold]mall[/gold] and fall into thought.

You begin to suspect this [gold]mall[/gold] was waiting specifically for you to come in,
so you decide:

[b]Just keep sitting[/b]

[thinky_dots]After all, if you could leave, you'd have left already...[/thinky_dots]

After sitting for a while, you decide to sleep—there's nothing else to do anyway.

Just as you close your eyes, a [jitter]sensation of weightlessness[/jitter] washes over you, and you crash hard onto the ground.

When you get up, you find this isn't the path you took when you first entered the [gold]mall[/gold].
Turning the corner, you find a [gold][b]classroom that shouldn't exist[/b][/gold] at the end of the hallway.
[fly_in][orange]Warm yellow[/orange] light spills from the crack under the door[/fly_in], [sine][color=#cccccc]chalk dust[/color] drifting in the beam[/sine].

On the blackboard, written neatly, are the [orange]final exam rankings[/orange].
Two phantoms stand before the board—one [color=#7799CC]blue[/color], one [color=#FF8899]pink[/color].

The [color=#FF8899]pink-haired[/color] girl points at the top name on the list, smiling [sine]so widely her eyes curve[/sine].
[color=#FF8899]"Top of the grade! [gold]Anon Chihaya[/gold], top of the grade! How about it, want an autograph? Pre-orders are [gold]free[/gold]!"[/color]

No one responds to [color=#FF8899]her[/color].

The [color=#7799CC]blue-haired[/color] girl stands quietly before the name in second place, her fingertip resting on a line of small text at the bottom of the list.
[color=#7799CC]"[gold]Scholarship[/gold]...... with this, this year's tuition..."[/color]

The [color=#FF8899]pink-haired[/color] girl's smile freezes inch by inch.
Following that gaze, she finally makes out the [red]red annotation[/red]:
This year's scholarship recipient: [color=#FF8899]Anon Chihaya[/color].
[color=#FF8899]"Th-that... Sakiko-chan..."[/color]
[color=#7799CC]"...There's no need."[/color]

The two words fall light as snow, and the temperature in the classroom drops to [aqua]freezing[/aqua].
Raise your hand for an autograph
Lose [red]8[/red] HP, choose [blue]1[/blue] card from your [gold]deck[/gold] to remove.
"Sakiko-chan... Sakiko-chan... how about tutoring and sweets?"
"Sakiko-chan... Sakiko-chan... how about tutoring and sweets?"
Requires both [color=#FF8899]Anon Chihaya[/color] and [color=#7799CC]Sakiko Togawa[/color]  in your party.

[color=#FF8899]"Oh, oh... ah, sure, sure!"[/color]
Still wearing an awkward expression, the [color=#FF8899]pink-haired[/color] girl forces a smile and scribbles out her signature.

Somehow, your [gold]wallet[/gold] feels a little heavier.

As you leave the classroom clutching the [color=#FF8899]autograph[/color], the temperature behind you visibly [aqua]drops several more degrees[/aqua].

[fly_in]You cross your arms and whistle, looking like someone who [orange]enjoys watching a good fire[/orange].[/fly_in]

Two gazes nail you at once—one [jitter][color=#FF8899]burning with fury[/color][/jitter], one [thinky_dots][color=#7799CC]frosted over[/color][/thinky_dots].

By the time you come to, you're sitting at the other end of the hallway, your belongings scattered across the floor.
When you count them, no matter how you try, one is missing.

The [color=#FF8899]Anon[/color] in your party scratches her head and reluctantly raises her hand.
[color=#FF8899]"The scholarship thing... yeah, I took it. So, as compensation,"[/color] she counts on her fingers. [color=#FF8899]"We'll study together until dawn! I'll handle all the hard problems! And all the sweets are on me—the most expensive parfaits!"[/color]

The [color=#7799CC]blue-haired[/color] girl is silent for a long while.
[color=#7799CC]"...Hmph. Let's pretend that 'there's no need' just now never happened."[/color]
[color=#FF8899]"Ehehe, I knew it!"[/color]

The [color=#7799CC]Sakiko[/color] in your party grows annoyed at the sight, [sine]yet a [gold]flush[/gold] rises to her cheeks[/sine].
[color=#7799CC]"...As an equal exchange, I'll teach the music theory."[/color]
[color=#FF8899]"Deal!"[/color]

At some point, two desks have appeared side by side in the classroom, and a [gold]dessert shop[/gold] sign lights up at the end of the hallway.

The two [color=#FF8899]Anons[/color] argue endlessly over whether the [color=#77DD77]parfait[/color] should be [color=#FF8899]strawberry[/color] or [color=#77DD77]matcha[/color], while the two [color=#7799CC]blue[/color] figures have already opened [gold]the same notebook[/gold] side by side.

You quietly close the door.
In your hand, at some point, there is a [gold]notebook[/gold] filled with two kinds of [color=#FF8899]hand[/color][color=#7799CC]writing[/color].
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_EVENT_EMO_DUET_EVENT.tit: Duet of Pink and Black-Blue: What Is Emo?
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_EVENT_EMO_DUET_EVENT.pag:
Inside the Spire, you find a [sine][gold]door unlike any other.[/gold][/sine]

Before you even push [gold]that door[/gold] open, the sound of arguing slips through the crack.

Beyond it is a [gold]dressing room[/gold] that somehow still remains in the tower. The mirror is covered in dust, but the bulbs are still [gold]lit[/gold].

One [color=#7799CC]blue[/color] and one [color=#FF8899]pink[/color] phantom face each other across the vanity, [jitter]neither giving an inch[/jitter].
Enter the door and listen closely

[color=#7799CC]"...Emo? Treating such vague sentiments as an answer is proof of an amateur."[/color]
[color=#FF8899]"Hey! That's not right at all!"[/color]

The [color=#FF8899]pink-haired guitarist[/color] puffs out her cheeks and hugs [gold]the guitar in her arms[/gold].

[color=#FF8899]"That moment when [rainbow]the audience turns into a sea of light[/rainbow]—that's super Emo!"[/color]
[thinky_dots][color=#7799CC]"...Childish."[/color][/thinky_dots]
[color=#FF8899][jitter]"What is with this person!"[/jitter][/color]

Almost at the same time, two [color=#7799CC]gaz[/color][color=#FF8899]es[/color] nail you in place.
[color=#FF8899]"Perfect. Come settle this for us."[/color]
[color=#7799CC]"...Whatever. The answer is already decided."[/color]
Lose [red]8[/red] HP, choose [blue]1[/blue] card from your [gold]deck[/gold] to remove.
Requires both [color=#7799CC]Sakiko Togawa[/color] and [color=#FF8899]Anon Chihaya[/color] in your party.

You sit obediently at the vanity, serving as judge for the whole night.
As you listen, the topic drifts from argument into memories of each of their lives, and the lights seem to grow warmer.
As you leave, the [color=#FF8899]pink-haired girl[/color] waves at you.

[color=#FF8899]"Pretty Emo, right?"[/color]

For some reason, you nod sincerely.

[thinky_dots]While the [color=#FF8899]two[/color] [blue]of them[/blue] are [red]red in the face[/red], you edge along the wall toward the door.[/thinky_dots]

Just as your fingertips touch the handle, the speakers erupt with a [jitter]tearing roar[/jitter].

You and the door are blasted out together, [b]your belongings[/b] scattered across the floor, never to be fully gathered again.

[thinky_dots]You ask the question that silences the entire dressing room.[/thinky_dots]

The two [color=#FF8899]phan[/color][color=#77BBDD]toms[/color] are struck speechless, but the [color=#FF8899]two[/color] [color=#7799CC]in your party[/color] are already moving.
[color=#7799CC]Sakiko[/color] silently lifts the dusty lid of the piano in the corner, and [color=#FF8899]Anon[/color] spins her pick between her fingers.

[color=#FF8899]Pink strumming[/color] and [color=#7799CC]black-blue keys[/color] flow between the mirrors, [color=#FF8899]frank confession[/color] and [color=#7799CC]black reluctance[/color] finally layering into [rainbow]a single harmony[/rainbow].

When the song ends, the [color=#FF8899]phan[/color][color=#77BBDD]toms[/color] seem satisfied and fade away beneath the lights.

The two [color=#FF8899]Anons[/color] give a thumbs-up in unison.

In your hand, at some point, there is a mask—[color=#7799CC]half black-blue[/color], [color=#FF8899]half pink[/color].
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_EVENT_MASQUERADE_INVITAT:
You make your way through the Spire, slowly pressing forward along its winding corridors, yet you find yourself losing your way again and again.
After what feels like an eternity, the voice in your head begins to whisper to you.

The surroundings fall into complete darkness. Just as you raise your weapon, readying yourself to fight whatever threat may come, a voice speaks from behind you. A [color=#7799CC]blue-black gear-moon[/color] rises before your eyes.

"[color=#7799CC]...Welcome to [gold]Loft Moon[/gold].[/color]"

You do not respond immediately.

"[aqua]Looks like the type who has no self-awareness.[/aqua]"
"[red]No matter. Since you have come here, you are another one of the connected.[/red]"
"[color=#77DD77]Will you join tonight's masquerade?[/color]"
Lose [red]5[/red]% of your Max HP, remove [blue]1[/blue] card from your [gold]deck[/gold].
Cannot perform without [color=#7799CC]Sakiko Togawa[/color] in your party.

You nod, and your consciousness sinks into darkness.
When you wake, you are back on the original path, and for some reason, you feel refreshed.

You decide that trusting voices in the dark is unwise and shake your head.
The voice in the darkness sighs. A force pushes you out of this place, though something seems to have been knocked off along the way.

Even if it is only a phantom within the Spire, you still feel a faint desire to perform.
When the song ends, you find yourself back on the original path.
In your hand, a ticket to her first live has appeared.

[gold]Ume wa Pawa![/gold]
[color=#7799CC]Desuwa![/color]
[orange]Oh yeah![/orange]
...

You hear a bunch of strange cries from behind the bushes, which makes you very curious.
Fight a bunch of [orange]Fried Shrimp[/orange]. Upon victory, obtain some [gold]Little Toys[/gold].
Take [red]8[/red] damage, remove [blue]1[/blue] card from your [gold]deck[/gold].
Heal [green]30[/green]% of your Max HP. Fight a bunch of [orange]Fried Shrimp[/orange].

On the rugged path, you accidentally trip and also discard some unnecessary junk along the way.
You catch this bunch of [orange]Fried Shrimp[/orange]. They look very cute, so you decide to bring them along as you continue.
You rest comfortably for a while, but the [orange]Fried Shrimp[/orange] take the opportunity to scatter and disappear deep into the bushes.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_EVENT_HANEOKA_CORRIDOR_E: Haneoka Corridor

You walk with your head lowered, only to notice that the scenery around you is gradually changing, until a door appears ahead.
The faint sound of a piano drifts from within.
You glance up at the nameplate:
"Music Room"
Move closer to the door and listen
Obtain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Colorless[/gold] card reward.
Push open the door
Transform all your basic [gold]Strikes[/gold] into random [gold]Piano Performance[/gold] cards.
You push open the door, but there are no longer any basic Strikes in your deck.
Push open the door
Cannot open the door without [color=#7799CC]Sakiko Togawa[/color] in your party.
Push open the door
Obtain the relic [gold]The Girl with Flaxen Hair[/gold].
Push open the door
Cannot open the door without both [color=#7799CC]Sakiko Togawa[/color] and [color=#FF8899]Anon Chihaya[/color] in your party.

You approach the door, and the clear sound of the piano rings in your ears.
Many memories of the past surface, and you slowly close your eyes.
When the song ends and silence returns to your surroundings,
you open your eyes to find that the Music Room is nowhere to be seen.
Choose a basic [gold]Strike[/gold]

[color=#7799CC]Sakiko Togawa[/color] glances at the nameplate, then pushes open the door.
She knows this place. There is no way she could not.
In her darkest days, this was the only place where she could briefly forget the weight of life.
She walks to the piano and lets her fingers brush across its body.
Then, without lingering, [color=#7799CC]Sakiko Togawa[/color] turns and walks out the door.
"[red]I, do not fear oblivion[/red]"
You push open the door, but find the area beside the piano empty, with no sheet music in sight.

"Hey hey! [color=#7799CC]Sakiko-chan[/color], isn't this where we first met?" [color=#FF8899]Anon[/color] says as she pushes the door open.

"Ah... this place" [color=#7799CC]Sakiko[/color]'s gaze falls on the piano inside.

"[color=#7799CC]Sakiko-chan[/color], [color=#7799CC]Sakiko-chan[/color], can you play that song from when we first met again?" [color=#FF8899]Anon[/color] looks at [color=#7799CC]Sakiko[/color] with eager eyes.

"...Fine" [color=#7799CC]Sakiko[/color] takes a seat before the piano and begins to play.
Continue

At the piano, [color=#7799CC]Sakiko[/color] recalls many things—most of them not good.

[color=#7799CC](At least things are getting better now, aren't they)[/color]

[color=#7799CC]Sakiko[/color]'s gaze drifts to [color=#FF8899]Anon[/color], who is listening with closed eyes.
As the final note falls, [color=#FF8899]Anon[/color]'s voice follows.

"[color=#7799CC]Sakiko-chan[/color], that was amazing!" [color=#FF8899]Anon[/color] says as she claps.

"Thank you. But we should get going. It's best not to stay in a place like this for long." [color=#7799CC]Sakiko[/color] takes [color=#FF8899]Anon[/color]'s hand and walks out the door.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_EVENT_GOLD_DOG_EVENT.pag: While wandering the Spire, a [gold][b]large golden dog[/b][/gold] suddenly appears. It takes a great liking to you, licking you all over, which brings back memories of days gone by—both painful and joyful. It seems to want you to follow it. What will you do?
Fight two random Act 1 [red]Bosses[/red]. Upon victory, gain a [gold]Rare[/gold] relic and 2 [gold]Rare[/gold] card rewards.
After following it for a while, it leads you to a hidden treasure. You pat its head, and it happily departs.
After you leave, you fall into a trap. In this dark and lightless place, painful memories of the past seem to resurface. With great effort, you finally manage to escape.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_EVENT_COIN_PARKING_EVENT:
"I built this place with the idea of paving the way for [gold]young bands[/gold]."
"This isn't the final destination. It can't become a comfortable cradle."

You arrive at this memory-filled place, but now it's just a [gold]coin parking lot[/gold].
Heal [blue]10[/blue] HP, upgrade [blue]1[/blue] card in your [gold]deck[/gold].
Obtain the relic [gold]"The Cat That Died a Million Times"[/gold].
Cannot enter Space without [color=#77DD77]Rana[/color] in your party.
Lose [red]5[/red] HP, remove [blue]1[/blue] card from your [gold]deck[/gold].
You decide to stay here for a while... Before you know it, many cats have gathered around you. They must be regulars here. After enjoying this peaceful moment with the cats, you take your leave.

[color=#77DD77]Rana[/color] takes your hand and, navigating past warning signs and trash cans with practiced ease, drags you straight to a hidden corner behind the building. There stands an iron door, already stained with [orange]patches of rust[/orange].

You look at [color=#77DD77]Rana[/color], but she seems to have no intention of explaining. She lightly releases your hand, bends down, and begins feeling along the dusty wall. After a long moment, she finally fishes out a [gold]key[/gold] from somewhere.

[color=#77DD77]"Before the shop closed, I secretly kept a spare key. Grandma doesn't know."[/color]

With the turn of the hinges, you enter this [gold]place filled with so many memories[/gold].

[sine]You know what this place is.[/sine]

Reluctantly, you leave one of your belongings here, bidding farewell to the memories of the past.

But just as the [color=#FF8899]shop owner[/color] had her reasons for closing it down, it is time to move on.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_EVENT_ALLEY_SHADOW_CAT.p:
As you pass a dim, narrow alley, a [jitter]rustling[/jitter] sound comes from the side. Following the noise, you spot a sleek black cat buried headfirst in a small mountain of garbage cans, rummaging intently.

As if by [purple][b]telepathy[/b][/purple], the moment your gaze falls upon it, the cat twists its head and fixes you with its [purple]violet eyes[/purple]——
Obtain the relic [gold]Gaze of the Black Cat[/gold].

——A pair of sharp, strangely familiar, [purple]violet eyes[/purple].
As you draw near, its body lowers, every hair standing on end, its pupils shrinking with terror as if it has seen something [red][jitter]utterly horrifying[/jitter][/red].
You quickly turn to look behind you, but nothing is there.
When you turn back, the black cat has already vanished.

The [b]black cat[/b] gives you an odd feeling, so you decide to leave the alley.

As you walk away, you think you hear a meow. Turning back, you find the black cat has already gone.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_EVENT_GUITAR_EFFECTS_PED: Buy Effects Pedals

You come across a music shop on the roadside...
Inside, many effects pedals are for sale.

They seem like they could give your [color=#FF8899]guitar[/color] some unique sounds.
Jangly Distortion Pedal (50 Gold)
Choose a card and [gold]Enchant[/gold] it with: [purple]Perform[/purple].
Dual-Effect Pedal (100 Gold)
Choose three cards and [gold]Enchant[/gold] them with: [purple]Perform[/purple].
No money...
Quietly walk away.
You buy the jangly distortion pedal and give your [color=#FF8899]guitar[/color] a fresh tone.
The dual-effect pedal! Now your [color=#FF8899]guitar[/color] playing is even more dazzling!
You check your pockets and can only walk away quietly.

"Let me pay for it."

A gentle voice sounds from behind you. It's [color=#FF8899]Soyorin! Love![/color]
Accept the kindness
Choose three cards and [gold]Enchant[/gold] them with: [purple]Perform[/purple]. Also gain [blue]50[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
Return the pedal
Return the pedal and gain [blue]150[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].

Soyo pays for you and stuffs the change into your hand, then vanishes like a cool breeze.

[sine]As if she had never been there.[/sine]

You return the pedal. Soyo glares at you, then disappears in a resentful gust of wind.
[sine]You sheepishly leave with the [gold]money[/gold].[/sine]
